# system.registerCrossfireModule

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.3.1</span></div>

Register the TBS Crossfire Module.

```lua
system.registerCrossfireModule()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function init()
  system.registerCrossfireModule({configure = {name = "CRSF Configuration", create = create, wakeup = wakeup, event = event, close = close}})
end
```
